scope: The only permitted Round 8 amendment; all unlisted protocol fields remain unchanged.

association_component_bootstrap.replaces: seed by shared destination-clip crossed paired bootstrap
association_component_bootstrap.with: seed by one shared association-component multiset crossed paired bootstrap

derivation.edges: for every image i, undirected clip(i)--clip(q=1 source_map[i])
derivation.reason: Each q>0 primitive depends jointly on destination and source clips; q=1 components contain every lower-q dyad.

algorithm_per_replicate: sample five training-seed indices with replacement
sample one multiset of 1625 association-component indices with replacement
include every clip and every image in each selected component, retaining complete membership and multiplicity when selected repeatedly
use that one shared image-index vector for every selected seed, q, model, axis, and perturbation
when a seed is selected repeatedly, reuse its frozen output and the same shared component draw

unchanged_parameters.interval_scope: four pointwise axis-statistic intervals, not a simultaneous 95 percent family

association_component_bootstrap.prohibition: Do not run or retain destination-clip bootstrap as a competing inferential analysis.

bootstrap_bottleneck_order.full_sample_raw_seed_statistic: Within each seed, compute all required q curves and expected-direction adjacent steps, then take that seed's minimum adjacent step.
replicate_order: construct the one shared association-component image-index vector
for each selected seed, recompute all q curve points for the axis on that vector
within that seed, compute all expected-direction adjacent steps and take their minimum as its seed bottleneck
average the five selected seed bottlenecks to obtain the replicate statistic
bootstrap_bottleneck_order.mean_curve_check: Separately compute q-wise component means across the five unresampled seeds and require no adjacent expected-direction reversal; this does not replace the bottleneck statistic.

q0_reproduction_boundary.A_R_C1: At q=0, A/R and correct-pair C1 point estimates must exactly reproduce Round 7 for every seed.
q0_reproduction_boundary.S_primitives: At q=0, calibrated predictions, exact-set errors, and confidence values must exactly reproduce Round 7.
q0_reproduction_boundary.S_round7_bridge: At q=0, secondary canonical-stable AURC, UAR@90, correctness AUROC, and ECE must exactly reproduce Round 7.
q0_reproduction_boundary.S_round8_primary: Tie-averaged AURC is the new frozen Round 8 primary convention; it must pass independent closed-form and brute-force synthetic tests and is not required to equal Round 7 canonical-stable AURC when confidence ties exist.

gate_and_claim_boundary.A_gate: Only the two four-label Macro-F1 curves are required components; Micro-F1 and per-class curves are diagnostics.
gate_and_claim_boundary.R_gate: Only the 21-label Macro-F1 curve is a required component; Micro-F1, coverage, and all per-class curves are diagnostics.
gate_and_claim_boundary.S_gate: Only the two tie-averaged AURC curves are required components; stable AURC, UAR@90, correctness AUROC, ECE, and decile diagnostics are diagnostics. ECE remains non-directional.
gate_and_claim_boundary.C1_gate: Only two action mean-three flip curves and one rationale mean-three Jaccard curve are required components; individual perturbation curves are diagnostics.
gate_and_claim_boundary.full_suite: All four fixed axis gates must pass; no passing subset may be relabeled as a full Round 8 pass.
gate_and_claim_boundary.conditionality_term: Replace clip-cluster-conditional with association-component-cluster-conditional in any permitted claim.
gate_and_claim_boundary.strongest_permitted_pass_claim: In the five frozen BDD-OIA training seeds, under one outcome-blind nested association map and association-component-cluster conditional inference, A/R Macro-F1, S tie-averaged AURC, and C1 mean-three correspondence metrics satisfy the preregistered strict adjacent-step monotonic response gates.
does_not_support: construct, ontology, grounding, faithfulness, causal, or real-safety validity
monotonicity of A/R Micro-F1, every R class, every C1 perturbation, or S diagnostics
other maps, salts, thresholds, models, training protocols, datasets, or real driving

required: final analysis core and synthetic tests
pre-outcome implementation and input hash manifest
independent Amendment 01 compliance memo with explicit GO
preflight_requirements: exactly reproduce all component partition and map closure invariants
prove one shared component draw with complete-membership multiplicity
split stable-tie q=0 reproduction from tie-averaged primary
bind all final code, test, protocol, review, input, cache, calibration, map, component, and Round 7 reference hashes
implementation_freeze_before_formal_outc.formal_outcome_stop: No q-response outcome may be computed until the independent compliance memo says GO and all frozen preflight checks pass.

unchanged_and_prohibited: Do not change the q grid, active counts, cycle order, pair/triplet construction, salt, or source arrays.
Do not change cache, calibration, threshold, training seed, model, perturbation, or input population.
Do not change tie-averaged AURC, the within-axis minimum adjacent-step bottleneck, the axis components, the 4-of-5 rule, the CI level, or 2000 replicates.
Do not replace a failed bottleneck with an endpoint slope, rank trend, selected q pair, selected model, selected perturbation, or relaxed gate.
Do not inspect q-response outcomes and then revise this amendment.
failure_policy: Any missing amendment item, hash mismatch, failed component invariant, or non-GO compliance review stops formal Round 8 without changing this protocol.
